prompt:
Use the attached reference image as the exact character design reference.
Generate a full-body 2D side-scrolling sprite sheet for Unity using this character. Keep the character in the same style as the reference image. The character must remain visually consistent across all frames, with crisp, polished game-ready rendering, clean confident linework, and appealing, expressive posing that reads instantly in motion.
Create a clean orthographic side-view sprite sheet. The character should face RIGHT in every frame only. Full body must be visible in every frame. Keep the camera fixed, keep the character at a consistent scale, keep the ground level consistent, and keep the body centered within each frame. No perspective change, no motion blur, no extra props, no extra characters, no cropped limbs, and no background details.
Output one complete sprite sheet with a uniform grid. CRITICAL: the total image size must be EXACTLY 2560x1024 pixels — 10 columns (matching the row with the most frames) by 4 rows of 256x256 cells. The grid must start at the very top-left corner (0,0) and end exactly at the bottom-right corner of the image, with no extra margin, border, or padding around the sheet, so every cell boundary falls exactly on multiples of 256 pixels. Rows with fewer frames must leave their remaining cells completely empty. Every cell must be exactly 256x256 pixels, including the empty padding around the character, so that every frame occupies the same amount of space and the sheet can be sliced into equal cells. Place the character at the same position inside every cell: centered horizontally, with the feet on the same baseline. Use a plain solid pure white (#FFFFFF) background, perfectly uniform with no gradient, no vignette, and no shadows, so the background can be removed later. Do not draw any visible grid lines, cell borders, or separators between the cells. Do not add any text, UI, captions, labels, or decorative borders.
Arrange the sprite sheet in separate animation rows:
Row 1: WALK cycle, 8 frames. Smooth looping side-walk animation with a relaxed, natural rhythm — steady steps, gentle arm swing, and subtle up-and-down bob.
Row 2: RUN cycle, 8 frames. Faster and more energetic than walking, smooth looping animation with a strong forward lean, driving legs, pumping arms, and a clear airborne moment for dynamic momentum.
Row 3: BASIC ATTACK, 8 frames. One full attack motion with clear anticipation, a snappy powerful strike, readable impact, and controlled recovery, returning to the starting pose with punchy, weighty timing.
Row 4: DEATH animation, 10 frames. Clear dramatic hit reaction followed by a staggering collapse, ending in a defeated pose resting fully on the ground.
Important requirements:
- Keep the character proportions, outfit, and color palette identical in every frame.
- Make walk and run loop cleanly from the last frame back to the first frame.
- Keep silhouettes clear and readable for gameplay.
- Keep each frame fully inside its own cell, never touching or crossing cell boundaries.
- All cells must be identical in size, including padding, so the sheet can be sliced evenly on a uniform grid.
- The image dimensions must be exact multiples of 256: no cropping, no extra pixels, no outer margin. The first cell starts at pixel (0,0) and the last cell ends exactly at the image edge.
If supported, also export each individual frame separately using names like: walk_01 to walk_08, run_01 to run_08, attack_01 to attack_08, and death_01 to death_10. If separate frame export is not supported, generate only the complete sprite sheet.
